purpose: Separate generalization and generation quality on v14a8 high-rate overfit pulse without new optimizer/data/objective/architecture changes.

replay.teacher: 28 training authored gradient_clipping rows (four per family) selected with v14a6 sampler

metrics.heldout_continuation: Teacher-forced continuation CE and top1 of heldout chosen reference, mask prompt tokens, 32 rows, token-weighted, family-breakdown.
metrics.first_sentence: Extract up to first punctuation mark (.!?), score v14a4 family_sem_check route signal, family signal, explicit correction if false premise; automatic keyword surrogate, not factual human correctness.
metrics.eos_probability: Softmax probability at final position of complete teacher-forced heldout chosen reference answer, sum canonical <eos> ID3 and <|eot|> ID7, individually and combined. EOS not added to training targets.
metrics.repetition: Full greedy generated holdout answer trigram repetition using historical history.repetition_rate; pass threshold <0.45; record rate and count.
metrics.original_evaluation: Preserve original v14a8 32-row full-answer rubric and exact train-target NLL.
